Tap to retry starting Shizuku on %1$s, then approve the \"Allow USB debugging\" dialog on that device (tick \"Always allow\").
When the \"Allow USB debugging\" dialog appears, tick \"Always allow from this computer\" and tap Allow. This authorizes a fleet peer to keep Shizuku running here.

Shizuku\'s background service isn\'t running. Tap below to open the Shizuku app, then follow its on-screen instructions to start it (e.g. via wireless debugging, or wait for a peer device\'s automatic peer-start if this fleet has one assigned).
stayturgid-agent needs Shizuku\'s permission to control this device (start/stop the host service, run diagnostics). Tap below to request it, then approve the prompt in Shizuku.
Without notifications you won\'t see alerts when Shizuku\'s permission is lost, or when a peer device needs approval. Tap below to allow them.
